claims.text: The patch estimate effect on positive share at horizon 7 days was 12.61%.
The patch estimate effect on positive share at horizon 14 days was 11.81%.
There were 14 price unknown days during the window.
Off-topic negative reviews decreased by 0.06 percentage points in the window compared to baseline.
The total change decomposed into 7.03 percentage points from reviewer composition shift.
Reviewers with 50h to 200h of playtime represented 30.46% of reviews in the window.
Total positive share in the window was 53.50%.

report.summary: Total positive share in the window was 53.50 percent, with the patch estimate effect at a horizon of 7 days reaching 12.61 percent and at a horizon of 14 days reaching 11.81 percent. There were 14 price unknown days during the window. Off-topic negative reviews decreased by 0.06 percentage points in the window compared to baseline. The total change decomposed into 7.03 percentage points from reviewer composition shift. Reviewers with 50h to 200h of playtime represented 30.46 percent of reviews in the window. A change in who reviewed is the supported explanation. Off-topic reviews or a review bomb and noise or seasonality are ruled out, while the patch and a price change or sale are inconclusive.
